speaker: richard_field
text: Come in out of the court. It is market day at home. I never pass a Thursday but I know it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They will have the stalls up. What will you sell me?

speaker: richard_field
text: A quire of the Rochelle, if that is what you came for. Fourpence halfpenny to you, at trade.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Fourpence halfpenny. I have it.

speaker: richard_field
text: My Holinshed, Will. The second volume. I see the gap on the shelf every morning.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is under a cloth, and the cat keeps it. I have not brought it.

speaker: richard_field
text: I did not think you had. Sit a minute. I have a thing from across the river.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Say it. I am paying for the quire.

speaker: richard_field
text: At Lambeth, this week, the Archbishop and the Cambridge divines have agreed nine articles on predestination. Some are chosen before the world was made, and some are not.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nine.

speaker: richard_field
text: Nine. And a man cannot, by any doing of his own, move himself from the one list to the other. There is a clarity in it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Measure twice, and cut once. That is as much as I am fit for before dinner.

speaker: richard_field
text: You are agreeing with the proverb, and not with the articles. I am not deceived.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then let it go. What is the price of crown paper?

speaker: richard_field
text: I will not give you a price to hide behind. The quire is fourpence halfpenny. It is what you came for.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then that is what I am buying. I am not buying a ninth article.

speaker: richard_field
text: Take it. I approve the clarity, whether you hear it or leave it. Books outlive playhouses, and never draw prentices to break heads.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A sentence a man can finish is a kindness. I have paid you.

speaker: richard_field
text: Fourpence halfpenny. I have it. You keep your counsel, as the people who raised you kept theirs.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Wrap the quire. I am not writing this down.

speaker: richard_field
text: I did not ask you to. The till is right.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The paper is enough.

speaker: richard_field
text: Feel the weight, and go home by whatever street you like.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will go.

speaker: richard_field
text: God keep you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And you, Richard.
